source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Marissa,

I hope you had a fun trip to Croatia; it’s good to hear from you. The website and UI have both been taking shape well while I’ve been doing a lot of work on them. My immediate priority is fleshing out the website before it hopefully begins receiving substantial traffic.

Although it is not live yet, I’ve added a header menu along with related pages that are at different stages of completion. Two of these pages are solution descriptions for the platform and agents, as shown in the attached snapshots. Each page has space for a diagram, and I’ve already prepared rough drafts for those diagrams.

Could you help turn the drafts into production-ready versions that I can place on the site? If you cannot, perhaps you could recommend the best alternative approach.

The UI has also received further development and additional functionality, and I’m now calling it the Admin Workspace. I’ve settled on a look and feel and layout that I’m comfortable with, although the shades and tones still need a little polishing. I’ll send you a link so you can review it.

Regards,
Derek

value_updates.intended_use: placement on a website solution-description page

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
An hourly contract works for me for this kind of task, and I can probably modify our current contract accordingly. What rate should I enter? At this point, I just need to maintain control over expenses.

If they improve the first diagram, feel free to label customers with "phone", "email", and "message" and staff with "chat", "message", and "report". The second diagram should also have clockwise directional arrows.

routing_warnings.description: The customer and staff channel labels in this message apply to the first, omnichannel interaction diagram rather than the target cyclic-process diagram.
